short: M06 ahead for heard speech: autoencoder-coded vocoder target beats spectrograms in all five patients, but the gain rides on the coding, and synthesizer decoding dates to 2009.
position: The paper [@akbari2019] changes the decoding target (M06). For heard speech it is ahead: all 4 earlier heard-speech intracranial reconstruction studies in the ledger decode a spectrogram, and the model ordering repeats in five patients. The claim that synthesizer parameters had never been estimated from neural data does not hold [@guenther2009; @chakrabarti2015]. Raw vocoder parameters score below the spectrogram (ESTOI 0.30 against 0.40), so the gain belongs to an autoencoder trained on 80 hours of external speech. The listener test (M12) is standard: ten closed-set digits from an unnamed patient or aggregation.
